Class Registration

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.platform.Registration
public final class Registration extends Object
Registers the mod's content under its namespace the loader's way: Forge and NeoForge through deferred registers, Fabric directly into the vanilla registries. Each method returns the registered value's supplier, which is valid once the loader has run registration.
